issues.title_en: Typhoon Dolphin compounds extreme weather woes in the Philippines and eastern China
issues.summary: The influence of Typhoon Dolphin has reached the Philippines, causing floods in the northern region as it intensifies seasonal monsoon rains. Jhesset Enano reports from Manila. Meanwhile Hong Kong is sweltering in a heatwave fuelled by Typhoon Dolphin, with record temperatures logged on Sunday. Jeraldine Yap reports.
